name: WLED Effects
author: Adam Coulombe (community updates for FPP 8.x/9.x)
description: Adds a UI page with buttons to start/stop built-in WLED effects on Pixel Overlay Models. Updated for FPP 8.x and 9.x compatibility (new API endpoints, multisync fixes, no duplicates, auto-scroll). Tested on 9.4.

privacy.summary: Runs on this FPP player and talks only to the other FPP players you list in Multisync settings, to read their model names and start or stop WLED effects on them.

sends.what: a request for their overlay model list, and WLED effect start and stop commands
sends.why: to read model names and run effects on those players
